summary: ATIF Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO and director Shibin Yu effective July 14, 2026, due to personal reasons, with no disagreement with the company. The Board appointed CEO and Chairman Dr. Kamran Khan as interim CFO while a permanent CFO search is conducted. This is an abrupt, forced CFO departure and director resignation, not part of a routine meeting or proxy circular. The filing is a foreign private issuer equivalent of a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.02 departure of principal officer. Watch for any subsequent dissension or operational issues.
